audited_condition_or_check: Check record coverage across test split
finding_summary: Traces were generated only for 100 sample records out of 7375 test records (1.36% coverage). 98.64% of test evaluations have zero trace artifacts.
No traces were ever generated or saved for the 3688 validation records (Fold 8). The dedicated traces/ directory exists but is completely empty.

Test traces in sample_test_reasoning_traces.json originate from the unblinded test split with unverified authorization provenance. Under Section 4 instructions individual test traces cannot be opened or analyzed.

audited_condition_or_check: Check lead configuration vs. availability mask agreement
finding_summary: StructuredTraceGenerator strictly extracts active and masked leads directly from the 12-dimensional binary lead mask and records them in lead_observability.

audited_condition_or_check: Verify unavailable leads cannot contribute hidden waveform evidence
finding_summary: Morphological tokens for ST elevation ST depression and T inversion are zeroed out (torch.zeros_like) whenever lead_avail_mask is 0 preventing masked lead waveform contamination.

audited_condition_or_check: Audit handling of attention on unavailable lead tokens
finding_summary: When cross-attention attends to tokens of masked leads trace_generator.py explicitly detects lead absence and tags is_observable_in_mask: false.

audited_condition_or_check: Verify claimed findings match recorded observable criteria
finding_summary: Contradiction detection is implemented strictly for Heart Rate vs. SBRAD/STACH. No contradiction validation logic exists for AFIB RBBB LBBB 1AVB MI or NORM.

audited_condition_or_check: Distinguish unavailable evidence from negative evidence
finding_summary: In context_builder.py an unobserved/masked lead token and an active lead with a negative finding both map to identical zero embedding vectors conflating absence of evidence with evidence of absence at the feature level.

audited_condition_or_check: Check disease claims vs. physical lead availability
finding_summary: Top hypothesis is chosen purely by posterior argmax without verifying if essential anatomical leads are active allowing ungrounded disease claims (e.g. MI in single-lead II) with unobservable evidence.

Cross-attention weights represent post-hoc attention correlations across input tokens not faithful causal mechanisms. Natural-language traces must not be claimed as proof of faithful internal reasoning.
